about: P2's floor rerun (design/review-runs/floor-rerun.md, Grok r1 M1a; Alex, Q20261103-p2-2: "I approve the new runs."), step 2 of design/review-runs/README.md: round 3's floor rule, fixed before any record, on a fresh run of round 3's campaign with the new seed pair (127, 227). Six jobs, three per system, drafted in the lab queue's job format for the coordinator to copy into queues; not a queue itself, and nothing here has been submitted. Branch round3 of p2-typed-routing/typed-routing (public: Alex-Tsvetanov/paper-typed-routing). Commit: d4332f79b876df9c4ef032603ccd2f2237665326, the commit floor-rerun.md is frozen at (the plans t3/plans/rr2-*.json, t3/jobs/sets.py, the pair's manifest rows from 437013c, and the probe fix); later commits change only design/ and this file. Order on each system: the sets job, then the A/A run and campaign (t3/jobs/rr.py with rr2-aa-X.json then rr2-X.json), then the k-server run (t3/jobs/aa.py with rr2-aak-X.json); Linux first, then Windows, one campaign at a time. The plans are round 3's (rr-aa-X, rr-X, rr-aak-X) with only the pair changed, a test compares them key by key: mixed-disjoint, m = 1,000 and 100,000, R = 7 rounds of 1.5 s windows after p2gen's 0.1 s lead-in, each server started once per size with a 1 s warm-up, the same order seed, guards and reruns of host-spoiled rounds. They time the Release builds of p2r3-bringup-l and p2r3-bringup-w at 3ff814e50, the builds every round-3 record timed and the round-3 sanitizer records cover; no build, no download. The probe's guard: 0d6b22f changed bench/ct_msvc.py (H7's MSVC script, compiled into no binary) after 3ff814e50, so at 437013c rr.py and aa.py would refuse; d4332f7 leaves that one file out of the compiled-source comparison (floor-rerun.md, What changes; tests), every other compiled path and every binary's sha256 checked as before. Request sets: t3/jobs/sets.py makes the pair's two cells with the bring-up's e2e_requests into LAB_OUT, checks them against the rows of t3/requests-manifest.tsv (made on the desktop with the 3ff814e50 build of e2e_requests, twice, with identical digests; the same binary reproduces round 3's committed (111, 211) row at m = 1,000; the job ran end to end on the desktop into a scratch data_root), then adds them beside round 3's 160 cells in the plans' data_root and their rows to its manifest.tsv, which p2run's verify_sets reads; it overwrites nothing and stops before any change if a cell or row there differs. That check on each system is the cross-platform identity check of floor-rerun.md; if it fails on a system, the plan's fallback pair is (112, 212), whose plans are not drafted here. After the sets job, round 3's bring-up could not be run again unchanged with --complete (its sets folder holds 162 cells); it is not meant to be. On Windows the rr and aa jobs start at least 15 minutes after boot and only once the quiet check passes (the coordinator's rule of 2026-10-28); the sets job is untimed and may run in that wait. The analysis is committed before the runs: t3/rr_results.py --plan-set rr2, t3/rr_records.py --plan-set rr2 and t3/rr_macros.py --run rerun, writing results/rerun with macros prefixed Rerun. The summaries hold verdicts, shares, start-ups, memory and spacing, no rate.

jobs.note: Untimed. Makes the pair (127, 227) at m = 1,000 and 100,000 (mixed-disjoint, all.txt at both sizes as round 3's pair has it) with ~/lab/p2r3/build-3ff814e50's e2e_requests into LAB_OUT/sets, checks the rows against t3/requests-manifest.tsv, then copies the two cells into ~/lab/p2r3/sets and appends their two rows to its manifest.tsv; a cell or row already there must be the committed one (a second run changes nothing). Then every file of the two cells is hashed against its row and sets/manifest.tsv is checked against the committed manifest, all 162 cells. steps.txt names the step that stopped. expected_s: the desktop's 918 s scaled by the README's bounds for this step, at most 853 s on Linux and 2,034 s on Windows: about 385 s, rounded up to 450 s (the m = 100,000 cell's all.txt is most of it); timeout_s three times 853 s, round 3's bring-up time for its sets on this system, all 160 cells, the README's upper estimate. Boost off.
